name: Daba Myroad
source:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
L-Gaim's Headliner (its pilot). A young man from the planet Coam, Daba ventured forth from his hometown alongside his friend Mirawoo Kyao to enlist in Posaydal's regular army. Don't be deceived by his gentle facial features—Daba had a fiercely stubborn side to him, with a tendency to stop listening once he got going.
translation:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
L-Gaim's Headliner (its pilot). A young man from the planet Coam, Daba ventured forth from his hometown alongside his friend Mirawoo Kyao to enlist in Posaydal's regular army. Don't be deceived by his gentle facial features—Daba had a fiercely stubborn side to him, with a tendency to stop listening once he got going.
